tweet.text:
Codex limits just got tighter for GPT-6.2 users, and the price isn't moving.

OpenAI is emailing Codex users: some GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol requests, Ultrafast included, "used less of your allowance than intended." That's now corrected, so you "may notice" hitting your limit sooner.

• Price: unchanged
• Affected: Astra and Sol, incl. Ultrafast
• How much tighter: no number given

Our take: OpenAI should publish the real rate. Until then, check Settings → Usage before long Ultrafast runs.

The email, as several users shared it today 👇
